scheme_name: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners
other_conditions: Applicants must be native and resident of Kerala.
Applicants must be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) category (or above poverty line if both parents are in jail and a District Probation Officer report is provided).
Applicants must be children of prisoners whose parents are currently incarcerated.
Applicants must be studying in Class I to Degree/Professional courses.
For Degree/Professional courses, the institute must be a Government or Aided college inside Kerala.
benefits_summary: Scholarships ranging from ₹500 to ₹1500 per month are provided to children of prisoners for school and college expenses.
